text:
maria_sales: FYI SilverGate wants to run a POC this week. Key asks: qLoRA 13B variant, KV cache enabled, latency SLO ~150ms p50, PHI data -> KMS/HSM. Can we meet latency on Dedicated and what's the pricing delta?
ashok_se: quick q — is their traffic bursty or steady? also what batch/seq lengths are we planning for?
maria_sales: mostly short prompts, avg tokens/request ~60, bursty during business hours, 30-40 rps peaks in tests. they said experiment with 1-inference-per-req pattern.
taylor_ml: architecture note: qLoRA-13B + 4-bit quant works but tail latency depends on KV cache hit rate and batching. If KV cache warmed and prefix reuse high, 150ms p50 is plausible on A100/80GB if we avoid large batching windows.
ashok_se: got it. can you suggest a config we should spin in Dedicated?
taylor_ml: recommended minimal config: ```model_variant: qlora-13b-4bit
gpu: a100-80gb
replicas: 2
autoscale: min=2,max=6
batching: max_delay_ms=12,max_tokens=1024
kv_cache: enabled, per_shard=6GB``` That'll prioritize latency.
maria_sales: perfect — any compatibility caveats for our runtime?
taylor_ml: runtime supports qlora variants but verify adapter layers are standard HF format. Watch RMSNorm ops — older kernels slower; we have a kernel-path that mitigates but need to pin to runtime v1.18+. Also 4-bit quant means slightly higher compute per token vs 8-bit but memory wins.
jenna_cs: on the security side they need KMS integration and an audit log export for the POC. SilverGate runs in AWS account (VPC). Is Private deployment required?
sec-bot: checklist: KMS ok with Private. For Hosted/Dedicated we can use customer-managed CMK via cross-account key policies; needs legal signoff for PHI. Recommend Private for full control.
ops-bot: pricing note: reserved capacity with A100 pool + KV cache overhead. Rough estimate for the POC (2 replicas, burst to 6): monthly delta ~ $28k (GPU + infra) + engineering setup one-time. If they go Reserved 6mo, we can discount ~12%.
ashok_se: can we do a short spike test on Hosted to validate latency before committing to Dedicated/Private?
taylor_ml: yes — do a 1hr soak on Hosted with same runtime v1.18+ and kv_cache emulation. Use `--warm-prefix=yes` in the client to prefill KV. Expect 20-30% worse p50 on Hosted due to multi-tenant noise.
maria_sales: action items: 1) ops: spin Hosted spike (ashok) 2) ml: prepare runtime pin + adapter check (taylor) 3) cs/sec: draft KMS + consent language (jenna) 4) provide customer pricing estimate (ops-bot). I'll coordinate POC kickoff.
ashok_se: starting Hosted spike now, will post logs.
taylor_ml: I'll run compatibility checks on the adapter artifacts — ask them to upload the adapter tarball to the S3 share.
jenna_cs: I'll prepare KMS example policy and a short answer for the security questionnaire.
ops-bot: logged estimate ticket #POC-9831 and created a short pricing sheet link: https://redwood.example/poc-estimates/POC-9831
maria_sales: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update SilverGate with timeline and ask for the adapter tarball and a sample prompt set.
ashok_se: spike logs (first 10m): ```p50: 210ms, p95: 540ms, kv_hit_rate: 0.2``` warming in progress.
taylor_ml: that's expected for cold KV. Re-run after 15m warm; if kv_hit_rate >0.6 we should see p50 < 160ms.
maria_sales: noted. follow-ups after spike — please drop results in this thread.
